Step by step towards focus and balance! 🪜🚶‍♀️

​Walking on the Line is a classic Montessori activity designed to refine body movement, encourage self-control, and build grace and composure. By carefully balancing while holding objects, our children learn posture and deep concentration in a calm, supportive environment. 🌸💫

​📍 Prayag Montessori – Jayanagar Branch

​#prayagmontessori #Jayanagar #WalkingOnTheLine #MontessoriClassroom #GrossMotorSkills

Walking the line, building mind & body connection! 🧠✨
​Watch how our little learners practice precision, focus, and spatial awareness through this fun shape-guided balance activity! Gross-motor exercises like these help strengthen balance, improve body control, and boost concentration—all foundational steps in early child development. 🏃‍♂️🟡

​📍 Prayag Montessori – JP Nagar Branch

​#prayagmontessori #montessoriinaction #GrossMotorSkills #jpnagar #EarlyChildhoodEducation

Little hands, big focus! ⚽🎯

​The Pick and Stick Balls activity is more than just fun and games—it’s a power-packed workout for hand-eye coordination, balance, and fine/gross motor integration! Watch our energetic toddlers navigate their path with total concentration and joy. 🌟

​📍 Prayag Montessori – Padmanabhanagar Branch
